audit.whatIsWrong: The chart says the opposite of everything else on the page. Both layers give Gangplank levels 2, 3 and both item stages, yet whys[1] says 'punish the instant he steps up', whys[2] 'a trade his early kit can't answer', whys[3] 'your cooldown trade pattern out-tempos his barrel setup', whys[4] 'Hero's Entrance is your biggest spike', whys[5] 'your AP-tank first item still beats his single item', and only whys[6] hands him the game. diff also reads EVEN at 6/10.
audit.why: The prose describes a lane Galio owns from 2 through the first item and loses only at two items, and the headline number agrees: 60.71% over 28 games is the best win rate in this slice. The displayed chart contradicts both.
audit.corrected: Levels 2, 3, 4-5, 6 and first item flipped to Galio at 6/10 in both layers; 2+ items left with Gangplank; level 1 left as Skill. diff FAV at 4/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks 'Powder Kegs' — wrong name and, worse, a wrong idea. Every line tells you to trade 'when Powder Kegs is down'. Meanwhile Remove Scurvy, the ability that actually deletes Galio's win condition, is not mentioned once in that layer.
audit.why: The ability is Powder Keg, and its cooldown field is 0 — it is a charge-based placement, so there is no cooldown to wait out; the punish window is him stepping up to detonate one with Parrrley. Remove Scurvy is 22s at rank 1 and 'cures crowd control effects and restore[s] Health' — it removes your Shield of Durand taunt and heals him through your poke, which makes it the one timer that decides your all-in.
audit.corrected: Name fixed, the keg reframed as a step-up punish, and Remove Scurvy's 22s made the tracked cooldown across tldr, winCon, cooldown block, do's, don'ts, key interactions and the all-in windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why calls Stormsurge/Riftmaker your spike while the chart gave that stage to Gangplank, and phases[4].why ends with the boilerplate 'Reassess his ultimate too'.
audit.why: The real stages are Remove Scurvy at 2, Cannon Barrage at 6 (160s at rank 1, global), and Trinity Force plus Essence Reaver after. Galio's are the 2-3 punish window, level 6 and his first AP-tank item.
audit.corrected: Stage lines rebuilt, now consistent with the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is absent from both layers even though his cleanse also heals.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy restores health on a 22s rank-1 cooldown; against a poke-and-taunt Galio that heal is what resets the lane. Grievous Wounds is the item that makes the 2-3 window stick.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb added to itemization, the loading tip, the mid and late text and the 2+ items spike.

edits.before: This is your window. With Q-W-E online you punish every barrel he plants — let him commit to wiring a chain, then E in and W-taunt so he can't safely Parrrley the detonation. At 6 your Hero's Entrance changes the map: even if he's farming safe, R lets you flag onto his ganks and roams, and in lane it's a knockup-taunt all-in he can't escape without burning Remove Scurvy. Watch that W closely — if he holds it, it cleanses your taunt and your E knockup, so bait it with a fake E commit before you throw the real combo. Snowball this stretch hard, because every level after this trends back toward him.
edits.after: This is your window. With Q-W-E online you punish every barrel he plants — let him commit to wiring a chain, then E in and W-taunt so he can't safely Parrrley the detonation. At 6 your Hero's Entrance changes the map: even if he's farming safe, R lets you flag onto his ganks and roams, and in lane it's a knockup-taunt all-in he can't escape without burning Remove Scurvy. Watch that W closely — it is 22s at rank 1, it cures your taunt and it heals him, so bait it with a fake E and buy Oblivion Orb. Snowball this stretch hard, because everything after two items trends back to him.

edits.before: Late game flips to him and you have to play around it. A full-AD Gangplank makes your Shield of Durand nearly dead weight — its reduction is amplified against magic and refunds almost nothing against barrel crits, and once he has Trinity Force and Essence Reaver he chain-detonates from outside your E dash range. His global Cannon Barrage and Remove Scurvy self-cleanse out-tempo your cooldowns the moment he's itemized. Your value stops being the 1v1 and becomes Hero's Entrance presence — use R to win other lanes and teamfights instead of dueling a scaled GP, and close on the lead you built from 2 through 6.
edits.after: Late game flips to him and you have to play around it. His global Cannon Barrage and the Remove Scurvy cleanse-and-heal out-tempo your cooldowns, so keep Oblivion Orb on you. Your value stops being the 1v1 and becomes Hero's Entrance presence — use R to win other lanes and close on the lead you built from 2 through 6.

notes: _missing-interactions.json claims Cannon Barrage bypasses resistances from a trueDamage flag, but Riot's description for it only says 'slowing and damaging enemies' — no true damage — so I wrote no resistance-bypass claim. The content layer says Remove Scurvy cleanses your E knock-up as well as the taunt; Riot's text only says 'cure crowd control effects', and whether that includes an airborne is not in any local file, so my new lines say it cures the taunt and left the existing knock-up wording untouched rather than assert either way.
